remarks: Experience timeless Greenwich living in this beautifully updated 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath Colonial, ideally positioned in the sought-after Cos Cob neighborhood. Graced with natural light and refined finishes, the main level showcases a seamless flow between the custom kitchen, formal dining room, and spacious family room, each opening to a large deck and landscaped, fenced yard designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. A flexible bonus room on the main level offers an ideal home office or guest space. Upstairs, the serene primary suite features vaulted ceilings, generous closets, and a spa inspired bath with soaking tub and separate glass shower. Additional bedrooms are airy and inviting, complemented by well appointed baths. Fine details include hardwood floors, a fireplace, central air, laundry, and an attached garage. Set moments from top rated schools, shops, parks, and the Cos Cob Metro North station, this elegant residence blends luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of Greenwich's most desirable enclaves.
